text:
### Observed differences

- In the earlier window A02 and A01 were never observed (0 of 200 traces); in the later window A02 occurs in about 57 in 100 traces (113 of 200) — exactly once per trace, always as the final event — and A01 occurs in about 15 in 100 traces (30 of 200), once per trace at a late mean position of about 0.71. [OCC001, OCC002, POS001, POS002]
- A16 and A19 were terminal earlier: each appeared in about 20 and 29 in 100 traces respectively, always as the last event of its trace (relative position 1.0 with no spread). In the later window they appear in about 15 and 22 in 100 traces, sit at about 0.85, and every observed outgoing transition of both leads to A02. [OCC016, OCC019, POS015, POS018, DIR011, DIR014]
- A01 is followed by A16 in all 30 of its occurrences. The direct transitions into A16 seen earlier — from A10 (about 52 in 100 of A10's outgoing transitions) and from A17 (about 31 in 100) — are no longer taken; instead A10 leads to A01 in about 42 in 100 of its outgoing transitions and A17 to A01 in about 50 in 100. [DIR001, DIR007, DIR012]
- A09's participation halved, from about 37 to 20 in 100 traces, and its mean position moved from about 0.26 to 0.59. Earlier it led to A13 (about 48 in 100 of its outgoing transitions) or A14 (about 52 in 100); later it leads to A02 (about 51 in 100) or A13 (about 49 in 100). A07, which earlier led to A09 in about 49 in 100 of its outgoing transitions, now leads directly to A14 (about 51 in 100), and A09 is now entered from A03 (about 19 in 100 of A03's outgoing transitions). [OCC009, POS008, DIR002, DIR004, DIR006]
- A13, which never occurs without A09, fell from about 23 to 9 in 100 traces, while A14 became slightly more frequent (about 37 → 39 in 100) and much earlier (mean position about 0.39 → 0.20). [OCC013, OCC014, POS013, REL128]
- The always-together block A04/A06/A12 declined from about 51 to 44 in 100 traces, and many activities (A03, A07, A08, A10, A15, A17, A18, A20) now occur at earlier positions in the trace. [OCC004, OCC006, OCC012, REL056, POS003, POS006, POS007, POS009, POS014, POS016, POS017, POS019]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the way traces end was restructured in the later window: a new final activity A02 appears at the end of a majority of traces, and a new activity A01 appears between A10/A17 and A16. A02, unobserved earlier, terminates about 57 in 100 later traces and is reached from the previously terminal activities A16 and A19 — each of which was always the last event earlier and now leads to A02 in every observed transition — and from A09, which earlier led only to A13 or A14 and now leads to A02 in about half of its outgoing transitions. A01, also unobserved earlier, occurs in about 15 in 100 traces, always immediately followed by A16, and the direct A10→A16 and A17→A16 transitions observed earlier are replaced by A10→A01 and A17→A01. [OCC001, OCC002, POS001, POS002, POS015, POS018, DIR001, DIR006, DIR007, DIR011, DIR012, DIR014, REL001, REL015]

The signs are direct and consistent across occurrence, position, successor and relation indicators: A02 sits at the final position with zero spread while A16 and A19 shift from position 1.0 to about 0.85; the relation profiles show A01 before A16 (15 in 100 traces), A16 before A02 (15 in 100) and A19 before A02 (22 in 100); and the three routes into A02 (30 + 44 + 39 traces via A16, A19 and A09) add up exactly to A02's 113 traces, so they do not overlap. A02 also never co-occurs with the A04/A06/A12 block — every later trace contains exactly one of the two — so the new closing applies to the paths without that block. The differences are additions of activities and edges, not a re-weighting of existing alternatives. [OCC002, POS002, POS015, POS018, REL001, REL015, REL021, REL026, REL033, REL036]

Limitations: the occurrence, position, successor and relation items summarise the same traces, so they corroborate but do not independently confirm one another; and zero participation in the earlier window strictly means "not observed" rather than proven absent. The observed shifts are larger than the differences seen in about 199 of 200 random re-splits of the pooled data. [OCC001, OCC002]

Other differences: in the middle of the process, A07 now leads directly to A14 (about 51 in 100 of its outgoing transitions) where it earlier led to A09 (about 49 in 100), so A09 is bypassed on that path; A09 is entered from A03 rather than A07 and its participation halved; A13 fell from about 23 to 9 in 100 traces, while A14 occurs slightly more often and much earlier. The always-together block A04/A06/A12 declined from about 51 to 44 in 100 traces, and many activities (A03, A07, A08, A10, A15, A17, A18, A20) now occur at earlier positions. [DIR002, DIR004, OCC004, OCC006, OCC009, OCC012, OCC013, OCC014, POS003, POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009, POS013, POS014, POS016, POS017, POS019, REL056, REL128]

A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is that A01 and A02 already existed in the earlier window at rates too low to appear in the 200 earlier traces; the evidence cannot distinguish a newly introduced activity from a very rare one that went unsampled. [OCC001, OCC002]
